entities.summary: The three Statutes of Lithuania (1529, 1566, 1588) — codified legal systems considered among the most advanced in contemporary Europe. The Ruthenian chancery language, the multi-ethnic nobility (Lithuanian, Ruthenian, Tatar), and Vilnius as a cultural crossroads.
